name: Priscilu: The Trader [TimmyGG Edition]
teaser: The updated Priscilu. He quit his job at DMV, and became an officer in the military. Still smuggling weapons, though. Nothing changed there. Enjoy!
description_html:
Information

Please report any bugs or suggestions to the SPT Discord Mod Development Thread

THIS DOES REQUIRE VCQL!
DOWNLOAD HERE

This is an updated version of Reis’ and CilginDalgic’s “Priscilu: The Trader” mod.

Priscilu now comes with Insurance. It may be pricey however, his team of sloths are always on standby. You may be surprised on how quickly they may be able to find your stuff. IF they find your stuff.

For information about this mod, please visit the original mod pages here:

Reis’ Version

CilginDalgic’s Version

Thank you to Reis for allowing me to post an update.

Thank you to both for creating this mod and allowing me to turn it into what it is today.

I hope you enjoy!

If you need a mod to help with not being able to click on Traders because you installed more than 1, use this mod:

Kaeno’s Trader Scrolling

Installation

Download the mod, unzip it and drag and drop the “user” folder into the SPT_Folder.

Config

Adds Trader to Flea Market (true/false)

“AddTradertoFleaMarket”: true

Trader Refresh Time Minimum (seconds)

“traderRefreshMin”: 1800

Trader Refresh Time Maximum (seconds)

“traderRefreshMax”: 3600

Turn on Debug Logging

“debugLogging”: false

Randomize Stock (true/false)

“randomizeStockAvailable”: true

Percentage change of item being out of stock (number)

“outOfStockChance”: 15

Does the trader have unlimited stock? (true/false)

“unlimitedStock:”: false

Price Multiplier for trader stock

“priceMultiplier”: “1.0127”

Known Issues

  1. When playing with SPT-Realism and Priscilu Trader, noticing only 2 or 3 weapon presets available and only a handful of ammo

    • Open your SPT Realism config .exe in your user/mods folder then go to
      traders and the 3rd option should be “change item loyalty levels”. Turn that off since it changes what items are available.

    Fix for this compatibility issue (credits Chaos_Mortal)

  2. Any other compatibility issue between Priscilu Trader and SPT-Realism mod

    • To fix this, we suggest you disable everything related to “traders” on
      SPT-Realism config. After that, try to enable each one at a time to discover what are the conflicting config parameters.

  3. Any compatibility issue between Priscilu Trader and LATE TO THE PARTY mod

    • In LATE TO THE PARTY config, set “trader_stock_changes” to “false”

    Fix for this compatibility issue (credits lopas123)
